props.title: What Is Hot Stone Massage?
props.text: A hot stone massage is a full-body massage with smooth, heated basalt stones. The warmth softens the muscles before deeper work, so tension releases without strong pressure. Guests choose it when they want warmth rather than a firm massage.

items.question: What is a hot stone massage?
items.answer: Hot stone massage is a full-body massage that uses smooth, heated basalt stones placed on selected areas of the body alongside massage techniques. The warmth helps relax the muscles while the massage creates a deeper sense of relaxation. At Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak, sessions are 1 hour, 1.5 hours or 2 hours.

items.question: Are the stones in a hot stone massage very hot?
items.answer: No. At Spa Bali Moon, the basalt stones for hot stone massage are heated to a comfortable temperature and always tested before being placed on the body. Your therapist checks the temperature throughout the session and adjusts the warmth to your comfort level, so tell them if anything feels too warm.

items.question: What type of stones are used in a hot stone massage?
items.answer: Spa Bali Moon uses smooth basalt stones for hot stone massage because basalt naturally retains heat for longer, spreading warmth evenly through the massage. Larger stones are generally used on broader areas and smaller ones for focused warmth, with common placements on the back, shoulders, neck, legs, arms, hands and feet.

items.question: Is a hot stone massage better than a regular massage?
items.answer: Neither is better; they offer different experiences. A regular massage relies entirely on manual techniques, while a hot stone massage at Spa Bali Moon combines massage with heated basalt stones, so muscles soften before deeper work begins and tension releases without excessive pressure. It suits guests who prefer warmth to stronger pressure.

items.question: Can a hot stone massage help after travelling?
items.answer: Yes. Many guests choose a hot stone massage at Spa Bali Moon after long flights, sightseeing or active holidays, because the warmth of the heated basalt stones helps ease muscular tension and encourages relaxation.

items.question: Can I have a hot stone massage at my villa or hotel?
items.answer: Yes. A Spa Bali Moon therapist comes from our Seminyak spa to your villa, hotel or home with fresh linen, oils, the heated stones and everything else a hot stone massage needs. It costs the same as at the spa, plus a home service fee of IDR 75.000 per therapist in Seminyak, Petitenget and Kerobokan, or IDR 150.000 in Canggu, North Kuta and Kuta. Book on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144, 9am to 11pm.

items.question: How much does a hot stone massage cost in Seminyak?
items.answer: A hot stone massage at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak costs IDR 250.000 for 1 hour, IDR 380.000 for 1.5 hours and IDR 495.000 for 2 hours per person. Four packages from IDR 420.000 per person add a body scrub, cream bath, facial or pedicure. Home service at your villa or hotel adds IDR 75.000 per therapist in the Seminyak area.

items.question: How long does a hot stone massage take?
items.answer: A hot stone massage at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak takes 1 hour (IDR 250.000), 1.5 hours (IDR 380.000) or 2 hours (IDR 495.000) per person.

items.question: Can I book a hot stone massage for today?
items.answer: Often, yes, depending on availability. Message us on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144 between 9am and 11pm with the time you'd like. At our Seminyak spa we confirm the next free time; at a villa or hotel in the Seminyak area a therapist usually arrives within 30 to 60 minutes. For a set time, or for two or more guests, book earlier in the day.

items.question: Can I ask for a female or male therapist for my hot stone massage?
items.answer: Yes. Tell us your preference when you book your hot stone massage on WhatsApp and we'll arrange a female or male therapist, at our Seminyak spa or at your villa or hotel.
